sources.target: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-74B-A9B-24GB-GGUF, revision e0fecb69cb3e5e4c5e8a056fa2aec98c78e91246 (IQ2_XXS experts, NVFP4 Mamba projections, Q8_0 elsewhere)

benchmarks-2026-10-30.scope: Every table of BENCHMARKS.md, HTTP, measured October 30, 2026 (UTC).

gufo.build: cmake --preset release with the system ROCm 10.1 HIP compiler, not nix build: this host does not trust the binary cache, so the Nix toolchain would rebuild ROCm from source
gufo.note: The recorded revision is this pull request's commit before its benchmark documentation; the documentation commit changes no source.

reference.build: llama.cpp build 11969, Vulkan backend (the reference the port is qualified against), clean tree
reference.note: Reference artifacts record whichever Gufo revision was checked out when they ran; it does not affect llama-server.

benchmarks-2026-10-30.measurement: One warmed sample per point; each step ran through a host lock that rejects runs with foreign CPU or GPU load, after the APU cooled below 55 C (GPU) and 75 C (CPU). Package power averaged 120-138 W under load; the GPU ran at 2.6-2.8 GHz and reached up to 98 C.
